data: Tesla's fiscal 2023 results show solid top-line expansion, with revenue rising 18.8% to $96.8 billion from $81.5 billion in fiscal 2022. Profitability kept pace, as net income grew 19.4% to $15.0 billion in fiscal 2023 versus $12.6 billion a year earlier. The balance sheet expanded meaningfully. Total assets climbed to $106.6 billion at fiscal 2023 year-end from $82.3 billion in fiscal 2022, while total liabilities rose more modestly to $43.0 billion from $36.4 billion. Cash and cash equivalents were essentially flat at $16.4 billion in fiscal 2023 against $16.3 billion in fiscal 2022. The one soft spot was operating cash flow, which declined to $13.3 billion in fiscal 2023 from $14.7 billion in fiscal 2022. That divergence from earnings growth warrants monitoring, though Tesla's liquidity position remains robust.
